caption:
Some steaks are dinner. This one is the whole occasion. Our Wagyu ribeye carries the deepest marbling in our range — marbling grade 5 — and it's cut for the home cook chasing a restaurant result at their own table. From R1,950, it's the steak you bring out when the promotion lands, when the in-laws visit, or when an ordinary Saturday in Mzansi deserves something extraordinary. Sear it hot, rest it well, and let that marbling do all the talking — no fancy chef tricks needed. Not sure how much to order? Ask us for the portion size that suits your table and we'll sort you out. So tell us — who's searing one this weekend? Tag the steak lover who owes you a proper dinner.
